content.english: God, blessed and declared blessed by the mouths of all,
Spoke, and the world came into existence.

content.hebrew: הוֹפִֽיעַ בְּלֵב אִישׁ תָּם דֵּעוֹת בִּכְלָלָם,
content.transliteration: Hofi’a‘ belev ish tam de‘ot bikhlalam,
content.english: He caused universal knowledge to appear in the heart of the mild man,
Congregation: He dreamed, and behold, a ladder!   (Gen. 28:12)
[God] made [Jacob’s] mind ascend wondrously to heaven,
To reach the secret of the soul’s testimony.
To come upon the ladder, into all dwellings of wisdom,

content.hebrew: קהל: מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּֽיעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה.   (בראשית כח:יב – המשך)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Muts’tsav artsa verosho maggi’a‘ hash’shamayma.
content.english: Cong. [The ladder was] set up on the earth, with its top reaching heaven.  (ibid., cont.)
He saw the splendid Glory in his mind’s eye,

content.hebrew: לָבֹא בְמִשְׁכְּנֵי אֵל סְעִפָּיו הֹמִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ,
content.transliteration: Lavo vemishkenē El se‘ippav homim beḳirbo,
content.english: Such that his thoughts, churning about inside him, reached God’s dwelling places,
Until the seraphim came to the place where he was lying—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ. (בראשית כח:יב – המשך)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehinnē mal’akhē Elohim ‘olim veyoredim bo.
content.english: Cong. And behold, angels of God were ascending and descending on it! (ibid., cont.)
The master of the universe appeared to him.
With the kohl of understanding, He opened [Jacob’s eyes], and he saw His legions,
Fiery cherubim and ofannim were opposite him—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהִנֵּה יוי נִצָּב עָלָיו.    (בראשית כח:יג)
content.english: Cong. And behold, Adonai was standing over him!   (Gen. 28:13)
[God] tore [through to] the eyes of faith, in a vision,

content.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע בַּהֲקִיצוֹ מַה זֶּה וְעַל מַה זֶּה,
content.transliteration: Vayyeda‘ bahaḳitso ma zē ve‘al ma zē,
content.english: And when [Jacob] awoke, he knew what this all was,

content.hebrew: כִּי יֵשׁ לְכָל־יֵשׁ – אָכֵן יֵשׁ בָּזֶה אֶחֱזֶה,
content.transliteration: Ki yesh lekhol yesh – akhen yesh bazē eḥezē,
content.english: For the All has an Existent – indeed, I perceive an Existent here.

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה.  (בראשית כח:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayyira vayyomar ma nora hammaḳom hazzeh.
content.english: Cong. And in awe, he said: How awesome is this place!   (Gen. 28:17)
This is the gate to Adonai, God of heaven;
The righteous will go through it, to hover in between.
Angels accompanied him twice, when he set out and when he returned—

content.hebrew: קהל:וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנָֽיִם.  (בראשית לב:ג – המשך)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayyiḳra shem hammaḳom hahu maḥanayim.
content.english: Cong. And he called the name of that place Maḥanayim.  (Gen. 32:3)

content.transliteration: Lekha El, na’ē kol pē leromemekha
content.english: To You, God, it is fitting for every mouth to offer praise,
To tell of Your sweetness to all who pass through the world,

content.hebrew: כִּי מָקוֹם לֹא יְכִילֶֽךָ, וּבְלֵב דַּכָּא מְקוֹמֶֽךָ,
content.transliteration: Ki maḳom lo yekhilekha, uvlev dakka meḳomekha,
content.english: For no place can contain You, yet Your place is within the heart of the downtrodden,

content.hebrew: קהל: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ.    (תהלים קמ:יד)
content.english: Cong. Truly, the righteous give acknowledgment to Your name. (Ps. 140:14)

content.hebrew: חזן: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִ֖ים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ: (תהלים קמ:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Akh tsaddiḳim yodu lishmekha yeshevu yesharim et panekha:
content.english: Cantor: Truly, the righteous give acknowledgment to Your name; the upright sit facing You. (Ps. 140:14)

content.hebrew: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יו֑י אַף־אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים: (תהלים פט:ו)
content.transliteration: Veyodu shamayim pil’akha Adonai af emunatekha biḳhal ḳedoshim:
content.english: And heaven will acknowledge Your miracle, Adonai; and Your steadfastness is with the community of holy people. (Ps. 89:6)

content.hebrew: פְּד֤וּת ׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ: (תהלים קיא:ט)
content.transliteration: Pedut, shalaḥ le‘ammo tsivva le‘olam berito ḳadosh venora shemo:
content.english: He sent deliverance to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name! (Ps. 111:9)

content.hebrew: צַֽהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיהו יב:ו)
content.transliteration: Tsahali varonni yoshevet tsiyyon ki ḡadol beḳirbekh ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Rejoice and sing out, dweller of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great in your midst! (Isa. 12:6)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
